body: I do not know whether you are aware of this, but Aikido has flagged the listed packages with vulnerabilities. For 'quinn-proto',  'zerovec-derive', and 'zerovec' Aikido suggests updating them to 0.11.19, 0.11.5, and 0.11.8, respectively.
title: Please update 'quinn-proto',  'zerovec-derive', 'zerovec'
